One of the best Japanese western restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City
Dec 2025 • Friends
For people travelling to Ho Chi Minh City make a way to one of the best intimate Japanese/western style menu district in District 19.

It’s a find located in a quiet lane off a major entertainment precinct. A perfect place to go for business or pleasure or romantic dinner and then enjoying the nightlife only two minutes walk away.

The food is exceptional as well as the wine list and the atmosphere is the best. You’ll find anywhere in Ho Chi Minh City. If you like a jazz quiet setting for Real funky feel yet modern you have to come down and experience Restaurant.

The chef is equal to Michelin style and the Service is 2nd to none. The prices are very good in. This up market five star cuisine. 

Coming to Ho Chi Minh City every eight weeks for business this is the perfect place for a business dinner in a very relaxing and soft mood background 

An absolute must if I could give it six stars I would . I don’t know the owner, but I said to him you’re a very humble man and you’re not telling people in the world how good your restaurant is.

The customer is always wrong
Aug 2020
I used to love coming here - it's a Japanese owned and operated western-oriented menu but in a Japanese style. My first visit was on an awesome date night and I had a great time, and the food was excellent. Since then I've been back about 15 times and I've always enjoyed the service and food quality despite the high price point.

Until tonight.

A good friend who was visiting said he wanted steaks and I convinced him to try Kakinoki in Pham Viet Chanh, Binh Thanh, a Japanese enclave in Saigon. We ordered two beef tenderloins for about $30 each, which in Vietnam is a premium, although we were happy with the proposition of Aussie steaks prepared by a Japanese chef.

They provide only a butter knife, which itself was tantalizing because we hoped for a tender, tenderloin - it's in the name,

But instead we got a frozen dry tough and grizzly piece of rubber like a flat tire. Try as I may I could not cut it with the knife given. Disappointing to say the least.

Then I asked for a steak knife, to which the owner replied that they didn't have any. OK, so in that case can we send the steaks back. No, she said.We thought a bit and tried to eat some more but it was just too much of an effort and not enjoyable.

We asked if they could prepare something else instead - that was a no.

So now what to do about one of my favorite places giving poor service and poor food? I asked the owner about what we could do and she said she didn't care if we never came back - heartbreaking since I had been a loyal customer for a while.

I can't speculate about why our experience was so bad but I can say for sure when a business owner tell me that my patronage is not appreciated that's the last visit I will make. We paid for our food and were still hungry so we got tacos down the street.

Once again another horrible customer service moment with a business who can only see as far as today. Take the eggs instead of the goose.

If you want over priced food and poor service by self righteous capitalists, go for it.

A shocker
Jul 2020
Y partner and I arrived at 7.15pm. There was a table of 3 and a table of 2 there only. We ordered meatballs and a pizza. After 45 minutes a small bowl of 6 equally small meatballs arrived covered din what looked like crushed tine tomatoes, it had been microwaved not cooked. After and additional hour I asked where our pizza was and told it would be there in 10 minutes , after an additional 15 minute I enquired again and was told it will be there in 10 minutes. It didn’t arrive, so I cancelled and as for the bill for what we had had as we had been there fo 1 hour 50 minutes, With 7 people there just how long does it take to cook pizza? The managers/ owners were behind the bar enjoying drinks with a patron and initially didn’t care and brushed off my enquiry. Then the got upset that I was asking after almost 2 hours where our pizza was. I paid the bill, we left. When my partner and I got home we BOTH had stomach problems and diahorrea. Not only was the service appalling the food was “off” and gave us aches and pains and trips to the toilet but all that the management (X2) were interested in was having drinks with a patron at the bar. Totally irresponsible in attitude , quality of food and service. Go there at your own risk but suggest you give it a wide berth.
